_comment: PUBLIC descriptive details per position (never amounts). Keys are holding ids, as in /investments/<id>. Any field set here overrides the encrypted data: name, assetClass (Stocks, ETFs, Cryptocurrency, Real Estate, Bonds, Cash, Precious Metals, Private Investments, Other Assets), geography, industry, note, purchaseDate (YYYY-MM-DD), brand (shown on the card, e.g. "iShares"), accent (card colour, e.g. "#76B900"), art (card artwork: burst, rings, orbit, petals, facets, dots or waves; default chosen from the ticker), public (false = shown only as 'Undisclosed'). Edit on GitHub; the site rebuilds on commit.
